class.name: JustAMCPToolCategoryBridge
class.brief_description: Adapts a JustAMCP tool category into a registered toolset provider.
class.description: Bridges a single tool category to [JustAMCPToolsetRegistry] by forwarding schema collection and execution to [JustAMCPToolExecutor]. Used when modular toolsets expose category-scoped tools through discovery meta-tools.

method.name: execute_tool
method.description: Executes [param tool_name] within this bridge's category via [JustAMCPToolExecutor] and returns the tool response dictionary.

method.name: provide_tool_schemas
method.description: Returns MCP JSON schema dictionaries for tools in this bridge's category. Set [param register_only] for registration metadata only, or [param ignore_settings] to bypass editor filtering.
